Technology stocks were struggling in pre-market trading on Thursday.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Hortonworks ( HDP ) was trading more than 17% higher in Thursday's pre-market after the data-management company late Wednesday agreed to an all-stock merger with Cloudera ( CLDR ) in a deal expected to create a next-generation data platform provider. Under terms of the proposed stock swap, Cloudera stockholders will own 60% of the combined companies and Hortonworks investors holding the rest after receiving 1.305 Cloudera shares for each Hortonworks share they now own. The deal is expected to close in early 2019.
In other sector news:
(+) IZEA Worldwide ( IZEA ) jumped at one point almost 44% in Thursday's early trading after the online marketplace said its total bookings during Q3 increased 20% compared with the year-ago period to $9.5 million. Managed services bookings also saw a "strong rebound" from the trailing quarter, rising 62% from Q2 to $4.4 million.
(-) Rudolph Technologies ( RTEC ) retreated during Wednesday's late session after the machine-inspection technology company revised its Q3 revenue outlook to a new range expecting between $59 million to $61 million, below the Capital IQ consensus of $65.1 million. It also sees non-GAAP net income coming in between $0.22 to $0.25 per share, lagging the $0.35 per share analyst mean.
